subject: pol-dym
title: POL.DYM.------PROG.CONT.
description: Diagram in T(AF)M-24, paired with v1-p120-1. POL-DYM (political dynamics) is crossed with PROG-CONT (progressional continuance): the structural pairing the section's prose has been building toward — what does it mean to make political dynamics *continuous* with the progressional thrust of black creativity, rather than letting political dynamics merely *interrupt* progressional flow? POL-DYM is fed by EXT-FT (extended functionalism), DE-SPTL (despiritualization), and INFO-AF-B (information affinity basis), which is itself fed by INTL (intellectualism). POL-DYM outputs to MDT-DY (motivation dynamics), AF-NT (affinity nature), and PROG-CONT (the crossing partner). PROG-CONT then solid-links to T-C-IMP (time continuum implications). AF-NT branches to COS-P (cosmic particulars) and SOC-RT-P (social reality particulars). The structural argument: political dynamics is not autonomous — it is constituted *upstream* by extended-functionalism, despiritualization, and intellectualism-fed information-affinity-basis (the very combination Braxton identifies as the western philosophical apparatus). Its outputs spread into motivation dynamics and affinity nature, the latter splitting cosmic from social-reality particulars. The diagram thus stages the *constitution* of political dynamics that black creativity must contend with, and the only direct route to time-continuum implications runs through progressional continuance — not through any of the upstream constituents.
